title: Step to a tick more than +1 ahead runs one flow pass — demand entries at skipped ticks silently never fire
detail: Backward and equal ticks latch, but a forward jump (Tick > State.Tick+1) is unguarded: one FlowStep runs, so demands and log entries at skipped ticks never fire — silent divergence from per-tick replay.
recommended_fix: Latch ReplayError when Tick > State.Tick + 1 (or loop FlowStep per skipped tick) so multi-tick jumps cannot silently skip demand.

title: ApplyEdit has no terminal-barrier guard while Step freezes — post-terminal edits mutate serialized state
detail: The E17 freeze is enforced on one mutation path only: ApplyEdit still mutates Topology and appends to ActionLog (both serialized) after terminal — changing a frozen run's hash, unlatched.
recommended_fix: Check State.bTerminal in ApplyEdit and reject the edit (error or ReplayError latch) instead of mutating a terminal run.

title: FlowSpawn/FlowSeedDemand never validate Src/Dst — a demand naming a nonexistent node spawns an eternally waiting packet
detail: Node ids are monotonic, so a bad id can never become valid: the packet waits forever with no TTL, no cull, no latch — silently riding the serialized state.
recommended_fix: Validate Src/Dst via NodeSlot at spawn (or seed) time and fail loud — error return or ReplayError latch for a missing-node demand.
